title_zh: 苹果明年新品计划曝光：iPhone 18、新款 MacBook Neo 春季登场
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，苹果计划在明年 2 月至 3 月的 iOS 27.4 更新周期内，集中推出多款新品，包括新款入门级 iPad、iPhone 18e、MacBook Neo、标准版 iPhone 18，以及新款 MacBook Air。

其中，新一代 MacBook Neo 的产品代号为 J701，预计从现款 A18 Pro 芯片升级至 A19 Pro，支持 12GB 内存，并提升处理器与图形性能。

记者 Mark Gurman 表示，苹果已将 MacBook Neo 纳入年度更新周期，与 MacBook Air、MacBook Pro 保持一致，以进一步争夺入门级 Windows PC 和 Chromebook 市场。此外，苹果还计划更频繁地调整 MacBook Neo 的机身配色。

除了上述五款产品，苹果还在准备 OLED 屏幕版 iPad Air、新款 iPad Pro，以及第二代 iPhone Air。这三款产品同样计划在明年上半年推出，但从目前的生产排期来看，进度略晚于入门级产品。

Gurman 预计，考虑到明年上半年的新品数量较多，苹果可能延续今年秋季的发布策略，将不同产品分批推出，而非集中在同一场发布会上。这也符合苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 希望将新品发布更均匀地分布在全年不同时段的规划。

至于明年下半年，苹果预计还将推出新款 Apple Watch、iPhone 20、智能眼镜，以及配备摄像头的 AirPods。按照目前的产品规划，2027 年苹果的硬件更新将覆盖手机、平板、电脑、可穿戴设备及智能眼镜等多个品类。

🔗 相关阅读：iPhone 18 大更新，明年春天见！但苹果的挑战才刚刚开始
title_en: Apple's 2026 Hardware Roadmap Leaks: MacBook Neo, iPhone 18, and Smart Glasses Ahead
content_en:
Apple is preparing an ambitious hardware lineup starting in early 2026, according to a report from Bloomberg. The tech giant plans to rollout several new devices between February and March during its iOS update cycle, including an entry-level iPad, the iPhone 18e, the standard iPhone 18, a refreshed MacBook Air, and an updated MacBook Neo.

The next-generation MacBook Neo (codenamed J701) is expected to feature an upgraded A19 Pro chip, 12GB of unified memory, and improved processing performance. Apple has reportedly brought the Neo into an annual refresh cycle alongside the MacBook Air and Pro lines to aggressively target the entry-level Windows PC and Chromebook markets.

Additional devices planned for the first half of 2026 include an OLED iPad Air, a redesigned iPad Pro, and a second-generation iPhone Air. To avoid cluttering announcements, Apple plans to stagger these launches across multiple releases rather than hosting a single event, aligning with CEO John Ternus’s strategy of spreading product debuts evenly throughout the year.

Looking further ahead into the second half of 2026 and 2027, Apple's roadmap features new Apple Watches, the iPhone 20 series, camera-equipped AirPods, and smart glasses, signaling a massive multi-year expansion across mobile, computing, and wearable categories.

title_zh: Claude 的黎曼猜想证明获 Lean 官方认证
content_zh:
11 月 20 日，Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 宣布，在 AI 模型 Claude 的协助下，他可能已经找到了黎曼猜想（Riemann Hypothesis）的证明，并公开了约 1700 万行 Lean 形式化证明代码。

11 月 21 日，Lean FRO 和 Mathlib Initiative 公开表示，对这项证明的正确性有充分信心，并确认代码通过多项独立检查。麻省理工学院数学家 Andrew Sutherland 公布的验证结果显示，全部 175187 个 Lean 模块成功编译，多个独立证明检查器也接受了相关结果。

不过，这项成果随后迎来新的争议。数学家 Jenny Lorraine Nielsen 在 PhilArchive 发布论文，质疑证明中存在「空洞真值」问题。

她指出，代码中的 anyGeometry 谓词被定义为恒真，可能导致部分原本需要满足的几何条件失去约束，从而影响证明的有效性。

后续代码审查确认了这一特殊定义的存在，但它是否足以推翻最终结论，尚未得到确认。截至目前，Lean 与 Mathlib 社区尚未撤回此前的认证声明，相关争议仍有待进一步核查。

黎曼猜想由德国数学家伯恩哈德·黎曼于 1859 年提出，涉及素数的分布规律，是现代数学最重要的未解难题之一，也是克雷数学研究所设立的七大「千禧年数学难题」之一，悬赏金额为 100 万美元。

这一进展此前还引发马斯克的关注。他在 X 平台发文，用「🤯」表达惊讶，并指出，如果黎曼猜想得到证明，此前依赖该猜想成立的其他数学定理也将获得无条件成立的依据。

目前，这项成果已通过形式化证明系统的多重检查，但数学界仍在审查其数学内容，克雷数学研究所也尚未正式宣布黎曼猜想获得解决。

🔗 相关阅读：Claude 黎曼猜想一夜通过形式化认证，马斯克点赞
title_en: Lean Community Verifies AI-Assisted Riemann Hypothesis Proof Amid Emerging Debates
content_en:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge recently announced a potential breakthrough on the Riemann Hypothesis, leveraging the AI model Claude to generate approximately 17 million lines of formal proof code in Lean. The achievement marks one of the most ambitious applications of AI in modern mathematics.

The Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative publicly expressed confidence in the proof's validity after extensive automated checks. Independent verification led by MIT mathematician Andrew Sutherland confirmed that all 175,187 Lean modules compiled cleanly without errors across multiple proof-checking engines. The milestone also caught the attention of Elon Musk, who noted on X that validating the hypothesis would instantly confirm countless dependent mathematical theories.

However, the accomplishment has faced initial scrutiny. Mathematician Jenny Lorraine Nielsen published a paper highlighting a potential "vacuous truth" flaw, pointing out that a key predicate (`anyGeometry`) in the codebase was defined as universally true, which might bypass essential geometric constraints.

While code reviewers confirmed the existence of this definition, its impact on the overarching proof remains unresolved. The Lean and Mathlib communities have not retracted their certification, and the Clay Mathematics Institute has yet to make any official statement regarding the $1 million Millennium Prize Problem.

title_zh: 丘成桐：AI 证明黎曼猜想，数学进入新纪元
content_zh:
据《科技日报》报道，针对 Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 借助 Claude 证明黎曼猜想一事，菲尔兹奖得主、清华大学求真书院院长丘成桐表示，这是一项具有里程碑意义的成果，意味着数学研究「进入了一个新的纪元」。

丘成桐认为，机器逐步拆解、核验数学推导的方式具有很高的可靠性，AI 正在改变传统数学研究的路径。未来，数学家可能更多地面对机器先给出答案、再由人类理解证明过程并提炼理论的研究模式。

同样获得菲尔兹奖的牛津大学教授詹姆斯·梅纳德表示，他有 98% 至 99% 的把握认为证明正确，但强调真正重要的是理解猜想为什么成立。

他预计，数学家可以先借助 AI 压缩庞大的证明材料，再逐步整理出人类能够理解的完整版本。

对于 AI 是否会取代数学家，丘成桐认为，提出重大科学问题仍然是 AI 的短板，人类在研究方向选择和原创理论构建方面具有不可替代的作用。
title_en: Fields Medalist Shing-Tung Yau Hails AI-Assisted Proof as the Dawn of a New Era in Mathematics
content_en:
Following Anthropic's announcement of an AI-assisted proof for the Riemann Hypothesis, Fields Medalist and Tsinghua University professor Shing-Tung Yau declared the milestone a defining moment that marks the beginning of a new era in mathematical research.

Yau emphasized that step-by-step automated logic verification offers unprecedented reliability, fundamental shifting traditional research methods. In this emerging paradigm, AI systems may first generate solutions, leaving human mathematicians to analyze the logic, distill key concepts, and construct overarching theories around the machine's output.

Echoing this perspective, Oxford mathematician and Fields Medalist James Maynard stated he is 98% to 99% confident in the proof's technical accuracy. However, Maynard noted that the primary challenge now lies in compressing the massive computer-generated codebase into a concise conceptual framework that human minds can digest.

Addressing concerns about AI replacing researchers, Yau reassured that human ingenuity remains irreplaceable. While AI excels at rigorous deduction, formulating fundamental scientific questions and setting strategic research directions remain uniquely human capabilities.

title_zh: 曝小米汽车欧洲团队再添一名前小鹏高管
content_zh:
据界面新闻援引知情人士消息，前小鹏汽车西欧及南欧董事总经理强顺强已于今年 9 月加入小米汽车，出任国际业务部欧洲区董事总经理，常驻德国。小米暂未回应界面新闻的置评请求。

强顺强 2019 年加入小鹏，次年转向海外业务。小鹏从挪威进入欧洲后逐步拓展至丹麦、荷兰和瑞典，他的职责也从单一市场的销售导入扩展到搭建多国经销网络。原小鹏北欧业务负责人 Jens Olsen 也于 9 月宣布加入小米汽车，负责北欧及中东欧业务。

雷军今年 4 月确认，德国将是小米汽车出海的首站。小米 9 月已与德国的 8 家经销商集团签署合作备忘录，筹建当地销售和售后网络。卢伟冰此前在业绩会上表示，小米汽车计划于 2027 年第三至第四季度启动海外业务。
title_en: Xiaomi EV Expands European Leadership Team with Former Xpeng Executives
content_en:
Xiaomi’s electric vehicle unit has bolstered its European expansion strategy by recruiting Qiang Shunqiang, former Managing Director of Western and Southern Europe at Xpeng Motors. Qiang joined Xiaomi EV in September as Managing Director for Europe within its international business division and is currently based in Germany.

His recruitment follows the hiring of Jens Olsen, former head of Xpeng’s Nordic operations, who also joined Xiaomi in September to oversee the Nordic, Central, and Eastern European markets. Qiang brings extensive market expansion experience, having led Xpeng's sales network development across Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Sweden.

Germany will serve as Xiaomi EV's initial market in Europe, as confirmed by CEO Lei Jun. The company signed memorandums of understanding with eight German dealer groups in September to build local sales and service networks ahead of its planned international market entry in late 2027.

title_zh: 神舟二十四号完成发射前最后一次全区合练
content_zh:
11 月 21 日，神舟二十四号任务在酒泉卫星发射中心完成发射前最后一次全区合练。据新华社报道，任务各系统已完成功能检查，设备运行稳定，发射场人员已就绪。

这次合练由北京航天飞行控制中心统一调度，酒泉卫星发射中心、西安卫星测控中心和任务各测控点共同参与，模拟从发射准备、点火升空到飞行过程中的各个技术状态。神舟二十四号船箭组合体已于 11 月 17 日转运至发射区。
title_en: Shenzhou-24 Mission Completes Final Pre-Launch Rehearsal
content_en:
China’s Shenzhou-24 space mission successfully completed its final full-system rehearsal at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on November 21, marking the last major operational milestone before liftoff.

Coordinated by the Beijing Aerospace Flight Control Center alongside tracking stations nationwide, the comprehensive drill simulated the entire sequence from launch preparations and ignition to flight execution. Officials confirmed that all systems are functioning stably and launch personnel are fully prepared.

The spacecraft and carrier rocket combination was previously transferred to the launch area on November 17 in preparation for the upcoming crewed mission.

title_zh: 《GTA VI》发售后，PS5 Pro 涨至 1.6 万元
content_zh:
据蓝鲸新闻 11 月 21 日报道，《GTA VI》发售两天后，天猫自营的港版 PS5 Pro 报价已达 15,999 元，得物上的港版报价为 12,056 元。

国行数字版在这两个电商平台的报价分别是 11,499 元和 8,899 元。蓝鲸新闻称，多个平台的报价比游戏发售当天普遍上涨 1,000 至 2,000 元。

主机游戏馆也迎来一波客流。蓝鲸新闻走访的多家门店里，有的工作日中午也开始满座，晚间包间需要提前预约。一家店的负责人说，这几天来的不少客人是专程体验《GTA VI》，门店营业额比平时接近翻倍。
title_en: PS5 Pro Prices Surge in China Following *Grand Theft Auto VI* Release
content_en:
Prices for the PlayStation 5 Pro have surged sharply in China following the launch of *Grand Theft Auto VI*, with Hong Kong imported units reaching up to 15,999 yuan (~$2,200) on major e-commerce platforms such as Tmall and Dewu.

Across multiple retail channels, console prices jumped by 1,000 to 2,000 yuan within just two days of the game's release. Official mainland digital editions have also seen steep price markups driven by intense consumer demand.

The excitement has also boosted offline gaming lounges, with venue operators reporting near-doubling daily revenues and fully booked private rooms as players gather to experience the game on high-performance hardware.

title_zh: 特斯拉开始向首批车主推送 FSD v15，车机新增实时道路画面
content_zh:
特斯拉宣布开始推送 FSD v15。特斯拉 AI 负责人阿肖克·埃卢斯瓦米表示，这次更新率先面向首批车主。马斯克此前称，公司计划在 12 月扩大推送范围。

车机新增 Tesla Reality View，用虚拟俯视视角实时重建车辆周围的道路，并把即将到来的转向提示显示在画面中。车主可在全屏道路画面、地图和分屏布局之间切换。马斯克在演示中还介绍，驾驶员可以点选画面中的具体停车点或下客点，让车辆以该位置为目标。

对于这套新界面，马斯克直接在 X 上评价称「FSD 就是现实版 GTA」。他还强调，画面完全由车载 AI 实时生成，没有使用游戏引擎，所需算力仅相当于 AI4 芯片上一个 TRIP 加速器的一半。

特斯拉将 v15 列为需驾驶员监督的 FSD 版本，使用时仍需注意路况并准备接管。

🔗 相关阅读：把「GTA」搬进汽车！特斯拉推送 FSD v15：一键自动寻路，真实度媲美人眼
title_en: Tesla Begins FSD v15 Rollout, Introducing Real-Time 3D "Reality View"
content_en:
Tesla has begun rolling out Full Self-Driving (FSD) v15 to an initial group of vehicle owners, according to Tesla AI head Ashok Elluswamy. Elon Musk previously indicated that a broader expansion of the update is slated for December.

The update introduces "Tesla Reality View," an in-car interface that reconstructs the vehicle's surrounding environment in real time from a bird's-eye perspective, complete with visual prompts for upcoming turns. Drivers can toggle between a full-screen 3D render, a standard map, and split-screen layouts. Musk also demonstrated a tap-to-target feature that allows drivers to select a precise parking or drop-off spot directly on the screen for the vehicle to navigate toward.

Describing the update on X as "real-life GTA," Musk emphasized that the visual rendering is generated entirely in real time by onboard AI without using a video game engine. He noted that the system consumes only half the processing power of a single TRIP accelerator on the AI4 chip. Despite the major UI overhaul, Tesla maintains that FSD v15 remains a supervised feature requiring active driver attention.

title_zh: AI 服务器供应商被曝在交货前提价，部分订单涨幅达 45%
content_zh:
据《金融时报》11 月 22 日报道，戴尔、慧与（HPE）、联想和超微电脑等供应商在签约数月后、设备即将交付时，向部分客户提出上调搭载英伟达芯片的 AI 服务器报价。知情人士称，有些订单的涨幅达到 45%。

报道提到，Jane Street、Optiver 和 Hudson River Trading 等交易机构受到波及。这些公司采购服务器，在自建数据中心运行交易研究所需的计算任务。

《金融时报》援引消息人士称，内存成本上涨是供应商提价的主要原因之一，一些新合同只给出参考价格，到交付时再确定实际支付金额。

英国交易公司 XTX Markets 今年 6 月已在爱尔兰起诉戴尔。据报道援引的诉讼文件，双方原先约定固定价格，戴尔后来以零部件涨价为由要求 XTX 补款才能提货。案件仍在审理。
title_en: AI Server Vendors Shock Clients with Last-Minute Price Hikes of Up to 45%
content_en:
Major AI server suppliers—including Dell, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), Lenovo, and Supermicro—are demanding steep price increases on Nvidia-powered servers just before delivery, months after contracts were signed, according to a report by the *Financial Times*. Sources familiar with the matter revealed that some order prices have surged by up to 45%.

The unexpected price hikes have impacted major quantitative trading firms such as Jane Street, Optiver, and Hudson River Trading, which rely on proprietary data centers running compute-heavy trading research.

Soaring memory component costs are cited as a primary driver behind the adjustments. Consequently, several vendors have shifted to offering only reference pricing in new contracts, with final amounts determined at delivery. The practice has already sparked legal battles: UK trading firm XTX Markets sued Dell in Ireland earlier this June, alleging Dell breached a fixed-price contract by demanding extra payments prior to handing over the hardware.

title_zh: 微软公布 Outlook 宕机最终报告，部分发往个人邮箱的邮件被退回
content_zh:
微软在最终事故报告中披露，11 月 12 日 Microsoft 365 服务中断期间，部分发往超过 30 天未使用的个人邮箱的邮件延迟到超过投递期限，发件人收到退信。企业邮箱方面，排队等待投递的邮件已全部送达。

报告指出，故障起于 Exchange Online 网络网关所用的一项特定 Windows 配置。计划维护降低了可用容量，部分 Teams 流量又切入这些网关，恰逢北美流量高峰。负载上升触发缺陷，部分服务器失去响应，流量自动转往其余网关，导致故障扩大。事故还延误了 Microsoft Defender for Office 的部分邮件投递后防护。
title_en: Microsoft Details Root Cause of Outlook Outage in Final Incident Report
content_en:
Microsoft has published its final post-mortem report regarding the November 12 Microsoft 365 service disruption. The company disclosed that certain emails sent to personal accounts inactive for over 30 days exceeded delivery time limits and bounced back to senders. Meanwhile, queued messages targeting enterprise mailboxes were eventually delivered without loss.

According to the report, the incident stemmed from a specific Windows configuration issue on Exchange Online network gateways. The underlying defect was triggered by a confluence of factors: scheduled maintenance reducing gateway capacity, an influx of Teams traffic redirected to those gateways, and peak usage hours in North America. The surge caused several servers to become unresponsive, automatically cascading heavy traffic onto remaining gateways and expanding the failure.

The overload also temporarily delayed post-delivery protection processing handled by Microsoft Defender for Office during the incident window.

title_zh: 飞行八年后，欧日联合探测器 BepiColombo 进入水星轨道
content_zh:
据美联社报道，欧洲航天局（ESA）确认，BepiColombo 已在当地时间 11 月 21 日进入水星轨道。探测器点火减速，由水星引力捕获。德国地面团队随后接收并分析遥测数据，在数小时后确认了入轨结果。

这项欧日联合任务于 2018 年发射，途中先后飞掠地球一次、金星两次和水星六次，借行星引力调整航线。两艘探测器目前仍连在一起，计划于 12 月 9 日至 10 日分离。它们将在不同高度分别观测水星的内部结构、地表和磁场，科学观测计划于 2027 年 4 月开始。
title_en: Joint European-Japanese BepiColombo Probe Enters Mercury's Orbit After 8-Year Journey
content_en:
The European Space Agency (ESA) confirmed that the joint European-Japanese spacecraft BepiColombo successfully entered Mercury's orbit on November 21. Ground teams in Germany verified the orbital insertion hours later following the analysis of telemetry data, after the probe fired its thrusters to slow down and allow Mercury's gravity to capture it.

Launched in 2018, the mission utilized multiple planetary gravity assists—flying past Earth once, Venus twice, and Mercury six times—to fine-tune its trajectory. The two connected probes are scheduled to separate between December 9 and 10, after which they will observe Mercury's internal structure, surface, and magnetic field from different altitudes. Full scientific observations are set to begin in April 2027.

title_zh: 韩国高考防作弊措施引争议，教育部长崔教振辞职获准
content_zh:
据韩联社报道，韩国教育部长官崔教振 11 月 22 日宣布辞职，为今年高考临近开考时多次调整防作弊措施引发的混乱承担责任。韩国总统李在明当天接受了他的辞呈，并要求国务总理韩成淑负责后续处置。

韩国高考于 11 月 19 日举行。教育部门最初着重防范智能眼镜，随后扩大到微型摄像头等设备，并在考前增派智能设备监测人员和走廊监考人员。

韩国国务调整室 20 日表示，相关部门将继续分析考试期间记录的 Wi-Fi 和蓝牙信号，涉嫌作弊的情况将移交调查。
title_en: South Korea's Education Minister Resigns Over Anti-Cheating Chaos at College Entrance Exam
content_en:
South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin announced his resignation on November 22, taking responsibility for the confusion caused by last-minute adjustments to anti-cheating protocols ahead of the national college entrance exam (CSAT). President Lee Jae-myung accepted the resignation on the same day and instructed Prime Minister Han Seong-sook to oversee the follow-up management.

The CSAT took place on November 19. Anti-cheating efforts initially targeted smart glasses but were hastily expanded to include micro-cameras and other devices, accompanied by last-minute deployments of device-monitoring staff and corridor invigilators.

South Korea's Office for Government Policy Coordination stated that authorities will continue analyzing Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signals recorded during the exam, with any suspected cheating cases being referred for formal investigation.

title_zh: MiniMax AI 攻破多个密码学方案，破解速度最高提升 4.3 万倍
content_zh:
11 月 22 日，MiniMax 公布最新内部 AI 模型的密码分析研究成果。官方表示，该模型发现了多个密码算法此前未知的安全缺陷，并实现了秒级破解。

其中，模型仅用 0.045 秒便攻破哈希算法 Waterfall-256，在 0.06 秒内恢复后量子签名方案 SBC-VOLE 的完整私钥。

在 TII McEliece 国际密钥恢复挑战赛中，模型累计破解 94 个挑战实例，其中 55 个为首次攻破，部分实例的求解速度较此前公开纪录提升约 6180 至 43400 倍。

MiniMax 强调，相关研究不影响 AES、RSA、SHA-256 等现行主流密码标准的安全性，目前已公开技术报告及代码。
title_en: MiniMax AI Cracks Cryptographic Algorithms, Accelerating Crack Speeds by Up to 43,400x
content_en:
AI firm MiniMax unveiled cryptanalytic research on November 22 from its latest internal model, demonstrating that the AI uncovered previously unknown security flaws in several cryptographic algorithms, achieving sub-second decryption times.

Notably, the model compromised the Waterfall-256 hash algorithm in just 0.045 seconds and recovered the complete private key for the post-quantum signature scheme SBC-VOLE within 0.06 seconds. In the TII McEliece Key Recovery Challenge, it solved 94 instances—55 of which were cracked for the first time—achieving speedups ranging from 6,180 to 43,400 times over previous public records.

MiniMax emphasized that the research does not impact the security of widely used mainstream encryption standards, such as AES, RSA, or SHA-256. The company has published both the technical report and the underlying codebase.

title_zh: 达美航空配载系统故障，美国约千架次航班延误
content_zh:
当地时间 11 月 22 日，达美航空用于计算飞机重量和载荷分布的自动化系统出现故障，波及亚特兰大枢纽及美国多地航班。据美联社援引航班追踪平台 FlightAware 的数据，截至当天下午，达美约有 1000 架次航班延误。达美表示，追踪平台记录的延误及取消中，约七成与系统故障有关，其余与恶劣天气有关。

美国联邦航空管理局当天上午一度暂停部分飞往亚特兰大的航班起飞，持续约一小时。故障期间，达美改用人工流程核算配载，让航班继续起飞。达美下午确认自动系统已恢复，并为受影响旅客改签，视情况提供餐食及住宿。
title_en: Delta Air Lines Weight-and-Balance Outage Delays Around 1,000 US Flights
content_en:
An automated weight-and-balance system failure at Delta Air Lines disrupted flights across the United States on November 22, severely impacting operations at its primary hub in Atlanta.

According to data from flight-tracking platform FlightAware, approximately 1,000 Delta flights were delayed by Friday afternoon. Delta stated that nearly 70% of the recorded disruptions were directly linked to the technical outage, with adverse weather causing the remainder.

During the peak of the disruption, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) briefly paused departures of select Atlanta-bound flights for about an hour. Delta temporarily transitioned to manual load-calculation processes to keep flights moving. The airline confirmed by Friday afternoon that its automated systems had been fully restored, and it was actively assisting affected passengers with rebookings, meals, and accommodations.

title_zh: 💡 皮克斯联合创始人谈 AI 时代的好莱坞：让观众更早看到作品
content_zh:
皮克斯联合创始人阿尔维·雷·史密斯（Alvy Ray Smith）、Baobab Studios 联合创始人莫琳·范（Maureen Fan）及莉齐·李（Lizzi Lee）在《大西洋月刊》联名撰文。

三人认为，年轻观众已经在 YouTube、Roblox 等平台认识自己喜欢的角色，好莱坞可以在项目开发阶段就放出短片或动态分镜，看看观众对哪些故事有反应。他们判断，AI 会让小团队更快做出样片，加速创作和观众向这些平台移动。

他们举了两个例子：《后室》最初是凯恩·帕森斯上传到 YouTube 的短片，在得到观众反馈后发展成系列；《地狱客栈》则先在 YouTube 放出由粉丝资助的试播集，积累观众后获得 A24 的剧集订单。作者认为，这类试水可以让制片方在投入大笔制作预算前了解作品有没有观众，导演仍负责筛选反馈，保留符合故事主线的意见。

三人还以中国手机竖屏短剧为例：单集短，制作、分发和回收反馈的周期也更紧凑，生成式 AI 更容易进入这种制作流程。他们认为，传统片厂把已有 IP 搬到短视频平台，只解决了分发的问题。

三人建议，传统片厂可以参照迪士尼早年与皮克斯的合作，把资金、发行和营销能力带给熟悉新平台的制作团队，并给这些团队足够的创作决策权。他们同时主张，对被用于训练 AI 模型的艺术作品，应通过授权等机制向创作者支付报酬。
title_en: Pixar Co-Founder Advocates Early Audience Testing and AI Prototyping for Hollywood
content_en:
In an op-ed published in *The Atlantic*, Pixar co-founder Alvy Ray Smith alongside Baobab Studios co-founders Maureen Fan and Lizzi Lee argued that Hollywood must adapt to shifting audience habits by sharing short concepts and animatics early on platforms such as YouTube and Roblox.

The authors believe generative AI will allow lean creative teams to rapidly prototype content, enabling studios to gauge audience interest before committing massive production budgets. They cited successful examples like *The Backrooms*, which evolved from a viral YouTube video into a feature project, and *Hazbin Hotel*, a fan-funded YouTube pilot that secured a series order from A24.

The piece also highlighted China's booming vertical short dramas as an agile, AI-friendly production model, noting that traditional studios merely reposting existing IP to short-video platforms miss the core opportunity.

The authors advised legacy studios to adopt partnership models similar to Disney's early collaboration with Pixar—providing distribution and funding while granting creative freedom to digital-native teams—and urged fair compensation for artists whose work is used to train AI models.

title_zh: 蔚来 ES9 推出地平线鎏金特别版
content_zh:
蔚来 ES9 地平线鎏金特别版于 11 月 21 日上市。整车购买 63.8 万元起，采用 BaaS 电池租用方案购买，车价 53 万元起。

新车以天山日出的三个时刻为设计主题，提供「鎏金拂晓」「鎏金晨曦」「鎏金朗照」三款外观，分别以极夜黑、M42 星云红和云白搭配双层金色腰线。车头、车尾的车标和悬浮轮标使用 24K 鎏金工艺。

座舱提供苏木红搭配云贝米、可可棕搭配帕米尔棕两套双色内饰，座椅头枕加入鎏金刺绣，门槛踏板上的山纹峰顶也做了金色处理。
title_en: NIO Launches ES9 Horizon Gold Special Edition
content_en:
NIO officially launched the ES9 Horizon Gold Special Edition on November 21, priced from 638,000 RMB for complete vehicle purchase or 530,000 RMB under its Battery-as-a-Service (BaaS) subscription plan.

The special edition takes design cues from three phases of sunrise over the Tianshan Mountains, offering exterior colorways titled "Gilded Dawn," "Gilded Daybreak," and "Gilded Radiance." The designs combine Deep Night Black, M42 Nebula Red, or Cloud White with dual-layer gold waistlines, complemented by 24K gold-plated badges and floating wheel logos.

Inside, the cabin offers two dual-tone interior options featuring gold-embroidered headrests and gold-finished mountain ridge motifs on the door sill plates.

title_zh: 国产冷冻电镜 TH-F120C 发布，核心部件实现自主研制
content_zh:
11 月 21 日，生物岛实验室牵头研制的冷冻透射电子显微镜 TH-F120C 在广州发布。据新华社报道，该设备的加速电压为 120kV，信息分辨率为 0.23 纳米，关键核心部件均由国内团队自主研制。广州实验室、中国科学院广州生物医药与健康研究院等参与了整机研发。

现场展示的实拍图像包括晶格条纹、蛋白颗粒和组织的超微结构。研发团队将这款设备定位于科研机构日常样品筛查和常规结构解析，可用于观察生物大分子和先进材料的微观结构。
title_en: China Unveils Domestically Developed Cryo-EM TH-F120C
content_en:
The TH-F120C, a cryo-transmission electron microscope led by the Bioisland Laboratory, was officially launched in Guangzhou on November 21. Featuring a 120kV accelerating voltage and an information resolution of 0.23 nanometers, the instrument relies on core components developed entirely by domestic engineering teams.

Jointly developed with institutions including the Guangzhou Laboratory and the Guangzhou Institutes of Biomedicine and Health under the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the device is tailored for routine sample screening and structural analysis. It primarily serves research applications involving biological macromolecules and advanced materials.

title_zh: 小鹏汇天 A868 完成倾转过渡试飞，从垂直起飞切换至平飞
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，小鹏汇天 11 月 22 日宣布，全尺寸电动飞行汽车 A868 完成倾转过渡试飞。样机垂直起飞后，机上旋翼转向，让飞行器进入高速平飞。

A868 去年 11 月完成首次起降试飞，采用全倾转构型，机上旋翼均可在垂直起降与水平飞行所需的角度之间切换。小鹏汇天计划将这款机型用于多人、中长途的空中出行。
title_en: XPeng AeroHT Achieves Successful Tilt-Transition Flight Test for A868 Flying Car
content_en:
XPeng AeroHT announced on November 22 that its full-scale electric flying car prototype, the A868, successfully completed a tilt-transition flight test. During the trial, the aircraft lifted off vertically before tilting its rotors to transition smoothly into high-speed forward flight.

Featuring a full-tilt rotor configuration, the A868 allows all onboard rotors to adjust between vertical takeoff/landing and horizontal flight angles. XPeng AeroHT plans to deploy this model for multi-passenger, medium-to-long-distance aerial mobility.

title_zh: 《终焉车站 暮色版》Switch 版在上海 WePlay 首次展出
content_zh:
11 月 21 日，独立游戏发行商 PLAYISM 在上海 WePlay 展出《终焉车站 暮色版》的 Nintendo Switch 版，这是该版本首次亮相展会。开发者 viv 制作的这款 2D 恐怖冒险游戏中，主角在末班车上坐过站，醒来后发现自己和一名同事被困在神秘的「终焉车站」。此次主机版收录游戏本体、DLC《黄昏电鉄》和两款迷你游戏。

同一展位还展出了《恶魔连结》和《灰烬之梦 CINERIS SOMNIA》。《终焉车站 暮色版》计划于 2027 年 3 月 25 日登陆 Nintendo Switch，支持简体中文和繁体中文，实体版已开启预订。
title_en: Nintendo Switch Version of 2D Horror Adventure 'Terminal Station: Dusk Edition' Debuts at WePlay Shanghai
content_en:
Indie game publisher PLAYISM showcased the Nintendo Switch version of *Terminal Station: Dusk Edition* for the first time at WePlay Shanghai on November 21. Developed by viv, this 2D horror adventure follows a protagonist who falls asleep on the last train, waking up trapped with a colleague at a eerie, mysterious station.

The upcoming console release bundles the main game with the *Twilight Railway* DLC and two minigames. Scheduled to launch on March 25, 2027, with support for Simplified and Traditional Chinese, physical edition pre-orders are now open.

title_zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》公布新版本，小刻将随旧水坝区域登场
content_zh:
《明日方舟：终末地》在 11 月 21 日的特别节目中公开了「穿越甚大蘑境与你相逢」版本预告。新版本将于 11 月 25 日上线，带来新干员小刻和新区域「旧水坝」，并开启「阵列建设：旧伤弥合」活动。

鹰角网络已上线新版本专题，玩家登录已创建角色的游戏账号后，可在 11 月 25 日 6 时前领取 1000 枚嵌晶玉等道具。节目尾声还公开了面向 2.0 的特别映像「基石」。
title_en: Arknights: Endfield Teases New Version Featuring Operator Ceobe and 'Old Dam' Area
content_en:
Hypergryph revealed a preview for the upcoming *Arknights: Endfield* update, titled "Through the Great Mushroom Realm to Meet You," during a special broadcast on November 21. Scheduled to launch on November 25, the update introduces new Operator Ceobe, the "Old Dam" region, and the event "Array Construction: Healing Old Wounds."

To celebrate the release, players who log in to their registered accounts before 6:00 AM on November 25 can claim in-game rewards, including 1,000 Originite Prime. The broadcast concluded with a special teaser video titled "Cornerstone," offering a first look at content planned for the game's 2.0 era.

title_zh: 比亚迪闪充枪超过 3.1 万个，覆盖 345 座城市
content_zh:
11 月 21 日，比亚迪更新闪充网络运营数据。截至 11 月 20 日，全国累计上线 31,014 个闪充枪，覆盖 345 座城市，闪充用户超过 357 万。

网通社援引的上一期统计显示，截至 9 月 30 日，比亚迪已上线 21,214 个闪充枪，覆盖 342 座城市。这段时间，覆盖城市增加了 3 座，已上线闪充枪增加了 9,800 个。比亚迪的闪充桩采用双枪设计，一把为支持闪充的车型供电，另一把兼容符合国标的其他车辆。
title_en: BYD Expands Flash-Charging Network to Over 31,000 Connectors Across 345 Cities
content_en:
BYD released its latest flash-charging network operational data on November 21. As of November 20, the automaker has deployed 31,014 flash-charging connectors across 345 cities nationwide, serving over 3.57 million users.

This marks rapid expansion since September 30, adding nearly 9,800 connectors and covering three additional cities in less than two months.

BYD’s charging piles feature a dual-connector design: one connector is dedicated to vehicles supporting BYD's proprietary ultra-fast flash charging, while the other remains compatible with standard electric vehicles conforming to national standards.

title_zh: 拓麻歌子迎来 30 周年，万代将在纽约时代广场举办纪念活动
content_zh:
1996 年 11 月 23 日，初代拓麻歌子（Tamagotchi）在日本发售。万代将于纽约当地时间 11 月 22 日晚，在时代广场播放一场 30 周年互动音乐秀，并在达菲广场布置巨型生日蛋糕。东京的周年活动已于 11 月 7 日从原宿和涩谷开始。

这款要定时喂食、照顾的钥匙扣电子宠物，后来陆续加入红外通信、彩色屏幕和 Wi-Fi。达菲广场的快闪区还会展出系列不同时期的设备，供到场观众试玩。
title_en: Tamagotchi Turns 30: Bandai Celebrates Anniversary in Times Square
content_en:
To mark the 30th anniversary of Tamagotchi—first released in Japan on November 23, 1996—Bandai will host a major celebration in New York's Times Square on the evening of November 22. The event will feature an interactive music show broadcast in Times Square alongside a giant birthday cake display in Father Duffy Square. Anniversary festivities are already underway in Tokyo, having launched on November 7 in Harajuku and Shibuya.

The iconic keychain virtual pet, famous for requiring regular feeding and care, has evolved over three decades to incorporate infrared tech, color displays, and Wi-Fi connectivity.

As part of the New York event, a pop-up showcase in Father Duffy Square will display Tamagotchi models from various eras, giving visitors a hands-on experience with the franchise's history.
